description: Compare a published cash option with 30 growing annuity payments after taxes, including present value and break-even rate.

cashValue.description: Published cash option in US dollars; do not infer it from a fixed ratio.

discountRate.description: Annual discount rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.04 for 4%.

jackpot.description: Advertised annuity total in US dollars.

otherIncome.description: Other annual income in US dollars before the standard deduction.

sharePercent.description: Your percentage of one winning ticket.

stateCode.description: US residence and ticket-purchase state, two-letter code. Cross-state claims are not modeled.

winners.description: Number of jackpot-winning tickets sharing the prize.

name: compare_lump_sum_annuity
title: Compare cash and annuity
